hypotheses.title: Pinaverium bromide extends lifespan in Drosophila
hypotheses.claim: Pinaverium bromide extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster. Supplementation with this compound will increase both median and maximum survival relative to untreated controls.
hypotheses.rationale: Modulation of calcium signalling and gut function can influence systemic ageing processes. A compound acting on these pathways may reduce age-related physiological decline and prolong survival.
hypotheses.prediction: Flies fed pinaverium bromide will show significantly longer median and maximum lifespan than vehicle-treated controls.
hypotheses.experiment: Raise matched cohorts on food with and without pinaverium bromide under identical conditions, maintain them throughout life, and compare survival curves by log-rank analysis.

hypotheses.title: Carnosine accelerates ageing in Drosophila
hypotheses.claim: Carnosine accelerates ageing in Drosophila melanogaster. Supplementation with this compound will shorten both median and maximum survival relative to untreated controls.
hypotheses.rationale: Histidine-containing dipeptides can perturb metal ion homeostasis and oxidative metabolism. Disruption of these balances may accelerate physiological decline and reduce survival.
hypotheses.prediction: Flies fed carnosine will show significantly shorter median and maximum lifespan than vehicle-treated controls.
hypotheses.experiment: Raise matched cohorts on food with and without carnosine under identical conditions, maintain them throughout life, and compare survival curves by log-rank analysis.

hypotheses.title: SKF95282 extends lifespan via insulin/IGF signalling
hypotheses.claim: SKF95282 extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster by activating the insulin/IGF signalling pathway. Supplementation will increase survival in parallel with measurable elevation of pathway activity.
hypotheses.rationale: The insulin/IGF signalling pathway regulates growth, metabolism and stress resistance, and its modulation can alter longevity. Activation of this pathway by SKF95282 may produce systemic changes that extend survival.
hypotheses.prediction: Flies fed SKF95282 will live significantly longer than controls and will show elevated markers of insulin/IGF pathway activity.
hypotheses.experiment: Maintain matched cohorts with and without SKF95282, measure lifespan, and quantify pathway activity through phosphorylated AKT levels and expression of insulin/IGF target genes.
